text: It’s very hard to find an honest clinic where you are not treated like a cash cow. And I have to say this is not one of them. I asked online to check my case and to recommend me the best treatment for my smile line. They asked for pictures, checked with the clinic, and recommended Ultraformer. I had no idea of what they were talking about and they explained that it’s a lifting procedure that will eradicate your wrinkles. Good, I book the appointment. On the day of the appointment the lady at the clinic looked at my wrinkles and said that IF after the treatment the result was not ideal I should consider a filler. Okay, it’s just a way to upsell, not a big issue. I get the treatment and I swear, my smile lines are EXACTLY the same. After the treatments the same lady had the audacity to ask me about the result. After discussing with her we figured out that she knew that the ultraformer wouldn’t have solved my issue but let me do it anyway. A fair establishment would have recognised the wrong assessment and proposed me a filler, not trying to make me pay for both. I am very disappointed. All this for mere 3000 thb. Or maybe it is because it’s very hard to apologise.
